en: A block and tackle pulley system with four rope segments allows a person to lift a 400-newton weight using only 100 newtons of force.
Rubber tires on dry asphalt have a friction coefficient of 0.8, which is about 25 times greater than the 0.03 coefficient of solid ice.
Earth's gravity pulls objects downward at an acceleration of 9.8 meters per second squared, while the Moon's gravity is only one-sixth as strong.
A neodymium magnet can lift up to 1,000 times its own weight, whereas a standard ceramic fridge magnet lifts only about one kilogram.
Lightning strikes heat the surrounding air to 30,000 degrees Celsius, which is five times hotter than the visible surface of the Sun.
Light travels at exactly 299,792 kilometers per second in a vacuum, allowing it to circle the Earth's equator about 7.5 times in one second.
Sound travels through air at about 343 meters per second, but it travels nearly 4.3 times faster through water at 1,480 meters per second.
Tungsten has the highest melting point of any metal at 3,422 degrees Celsius, which is nearly five times hotter than the melting point of aluminum.
A roller coaster at the top of a 50-meter hill has enough gravitational potential energy to reach speeds of over 110 kilometers per hour at the bottom.
A standard wood screw with ten threads per centimeter converts one full turn of a screwdriver into a forward movement of only one millimeter.
A skydiver falling in a belly-to-earth position experiences air resistance that limits their maximum terminal velocity to about 195 kilometers per hour.
Copper conducts heat more than 20 times faster than stainless steel, which is why professional cooking pans often use a thick copper bottom for even heating.
